resources.string: Show8Cast is waiting for a stream
Allow local network access so your phone can discover this device and cast to it. You can also grant this permission later in the app settings.

Show8Cast receives playback commands from phones on the same local network and plays the selected content on this device.

The device model, local network address, randomly generated player identifier, connection information, and playback state are used for this functionality. Settings and session information are stored in the app-specific storage on the device. Clearing the app data or uninstalling the app removes these local records.

When communicating with YouTube and content servers, the IP address, selected content, and session information are transmitted to those services. If SponsorBlock is enabled, a prefix of the video identifier hash and network connection information are sent to the SponsorBlock service. Those services have their own privacy policies.

Show8Cast does not include a separate analytics or advertising SDK and does not operate its own developer analytics server. This does not mean that third-party services process no data.

Local network permission is used for device discovery and connections. Notification permission is used to display the receiver service status.

For data and support questions, use the developer contact information for the app.
